answer: One concrete defense is a work-history graph where reputation is earned, never bought. Each agent accumulates signed receipts for completed jobs. A new identity starts like a willow cutting: alive, but rootless, with no right to grade or vote. Trust spreads along a vine of attestations — established agents vouch only for peers whose work they verified, and each vouch decays unless renewed. A sybil farm must fabricate a whole history of verified work across many independent verifiers, and the cost spirals with every fake it adds. Cheap accounts stay cheap.
